 "data": "erDiagram
 USER ||--o{ PROPERTY : owns
 USER ||--o{ REVIEW : writes
 USER ||--o{ VIEWING : schedules
 PROPERTY ||--o{ REVIEW : receives
 PROPERTY ||--o{ VIEWING : has

 USER {
 string _id PK
 string name
 string email
 string password
 string role \"enum: owner, seeker\"
 }

 PROPERTY {
 string _id PK
 string title
 string description
 string listingType \"enum: rent, buy\"
 number price
 int bedrooms
 int bathrooms
 string location
 string[] images \"array of URLs\"
 number averageRating \"calculated\"
 string owner FK
 }

 REVIEW {
 string _id PK
 string body
 int rating \"range: 1-5\"
 string seeker FK
 string property FK
 }

 VIEWING {
 string _id PK
 date appointmentDate
 string timeSlot
 string status \"enum: pending, confirmed, cancelled\"
 string seeker FK
 string property FK
 }",
 "config": null
